sources.note: Town of Enosburgh official Selectboard page (enosburghvt.org, current): lists five Selectboard members with term years: Dean Wright (Chair, 2026), Pierre Letourneau (Vice Chair, 2028), Larry Gervais (2027), Jessica Eagles (2026), and Nick Aldrich (2027); the live page seats all five after the March 2026 meeting. The Secretary of State directory publishes no Enosburgh roster.
Town of Enosburgh official Town Officers page (enosburghvt.org, current): lists 'Moderator - Elected, Patrick Hayes - 2026'.
Town of Enosburgh official Town Officers page (enosburghvt.org, current): lists Billie Jo Draper as elected Town Clerk, term to 2027.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Billie Draper as Town Clerk of Enosburgh; the town's fuller form governs.
Town of Enosburgh official Town Officers page (enosburghvt.org, current): lists Billie Jo Draper as elected Town Treasurer, term to 2027.
Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, 'Guide to Vermont's Town Clerks, Treasurers, & County Clerks' (January 2026): lists Billie Draper as Town Treasurer of Enosburgh.
Town of Enosburgh official Town Officers page (enosburghvt.org, current): heads the office 'Collector of Delinquent Taxes - Elected' but names no holder, so the seat is left unfilled. Structure only.

Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Enosburgh justices of the peace: Patricia Boucher, Timothy Stetson, Peter Perley, Sandra Murphy, Lucien Robtoy, Robert Young, Avis Gervais, Pierre Letourneau, Sarah Downes, and Angela Wright. Nine are minted; Avis Gervais died July 26, 2025 (see the election note) and her seat stands vacant.

jp_election.name: Town of Enosburgh Justice of the Peace Election 2024-11-05

sources.note: Vermont Secretary of State, Elections Division, '2025-2026 Vermont Justices of the Peace' listing (updated December 4, 2025): lists ten Enosburgh justices of the peace elected November 5, 2024: Patricia Boucher, Timothy Stetson, Peter Perley, Sandra Murphy, Lucien Robtoy, Robert Young, Avis Gervais, Pierre Letourneau, Sarah Downes, and Angela Wright. The listing publishes no vote totals or party labels and none are recorded. Avis Gervais died July 26, 2025 (the Village of Enosburg Falls 2025 Annual Report is dedicated in part to her memory), so no person or membership is minted for her and her seat stands vacant; the nine surviving winners are recorded here.

Village of Enosburg Falls Annual Report for the year ending December 31, 2025 (villageofenosburgfalls.org): the report is dedicated in part to the memory of Justice of the Peace Avis Gervais, who passed away July 26, 2025.
